entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: If you wish to attain true rehabilitation,[n]then we will continue to aid you...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: However, there is a matter that I must[n]caution you about first.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: The Personas you've acquired up to this[n]point can be wielded just as before...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: That is, save for Satanael, king of demons[n]and slayer of the evil God of Control...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: That Persona was a temporary force[n]you gained through the support of[n]the masses.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: As such, you will not be able to freely[n]summon Satanael for your bidding[n]at this time.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: However, I am happy to assist with[n]any other request you may have.
